typeAudit.evidence: H1 on article pages = 25px while decorative H2 on home page = 41px. Same Roboto Condensed family used at multiple weights (300, 500, 700) without a clear level→weight mapping. No modular ratio (1.125, 1.2, 1.25, 1.333, etc.) holds across observed sizes.
